permissions.edit_planning: Only users who can plan (superadmin, admin, president, vice president, technical director) can edit the planning.

griglia_guida.come_testo: Pick a name from the list below, keep it pressed and carry it into the session. You can take a whole group, for example “Pulcini”, or one athlete at a time. Coaches are moved the same way. If you prefer not to drag, use the “Add people” button above the session: the result is the same.
griglia_guida.come_breve: To add someone: keep a name pressed and carry it into the session, or use “Add people”.
griglia_guida.disp_fuori_fascia: {{orario}} is outside the availability declared for {{giorno}} ({{fasce}}).
griglia_guida.forza_puoi: You can go ahead anyway: write the reason, which is recorded with your name and the date.
griglia_guida.forza_non_puoi: To go ahead outside the declared availability you need the President or the Technical Director. Ask them, or choose another time or another person.
griglia_guida.forza_motivo_esempio: E.g. she is there that Saturday anyway, agreed with the rink
griglia_guida.pannello_descrizione: Session {{sessione}}. Tick who you want to add and confirm once.
griglia_guida.esito_in_coda: queued: continues after the current confirmation
griglia_guida.esito_in_attesa: waiting for your confirmation in the open window
griglia_guida.esito_errore: not added because of an error
griglia_guida.det_tutti_conflitto: All were already in an overlapping session.
griglia_guida.det_gia_presenti_other: All were already in this session ({{count}}).
griglia_guida.det_rifiutato: Saving was not accepted: check the permissions and try again.
griglia_guida.det_conflitto_atleti_one: {{count}} athlete is already in an overlapping session.
griglia_guida.det_conflitto_atleti_other: {{count}} athletes are already in an overlapping session.
griglia_guida.det_sessione_sparita: The session was changed by someone else: reload the page.
griglia_guida.det_gruppo_sovrapposto: The same group is already linked to an overlapping session.
griglia_guida.det_gruppo_gia_one: The group was already linked; list updated ({{count}} new).
griglia_guida.det_gruppo_gia_other: The group was already linked; list updated ({{count}} new).
griglia_guida.det_istr_forzato: Outside the declared availability, with the reason recorded.
